description: Vector letterhead header overlaid on scanned letter body

source.generation_method: Generated via tests/fixtures/hybrid/generate_hybrid_fixtures.py using reportlab with vector header (top 15%) and simulated scanned body (bottom 85%)

hybrid_behavior.vector_regions: Company name, address, contact info, date (top 15%, rows 0-1, columns 0-7)
hybrid_behavior.scanned_regions: Letter content, salutation, body paragraphs, signature (bottom 85%, rows 1-7)
hybrid_behavior.overlap_description: Clear boundary between vector header and scanned body with minimal overlap

classification_challenges: Clear regional separation may cause classifier to treat as separate Vector + Scanned regions rather than unified Hybrid page
Header extraction precision: ensuring vector header is not incorrectly subjected to OCR
Boundary detection: accurate identification of where vector content ends and scanned content begins
Tests non-overlapping merge rule behavior when regions are cleanly separated
test_focus: OCR on body only without interference from vector header
notes: Common business letter format; tests that vector header doesn't trigger OCR on header cells. Synthetic fixture with ACME Corporation letterhead placeholder content.
